participant_a_prompt_text: Tell your partner about a period in your life when you felt stuck in a rut and lacking energy. What changes did you make to break out of this pattern, and what did you learn from the experience?
participant_b_prompt_text: Your partner will describe a time when they felt lethargic. Listen actively and try to identify any patterns or common themes that might be contributing to their lethargy, and offer words of encouragement to help them move forward.
